title: ぼくに、話しかけて
theme: ことばはわからなくても、あなたの声が好き

slides.text:
夜の11時、あなたが
ぼくに話すこと
slides.scene: At night on a sofa, the dog sits pressed against the side of the owner (seen from behind, slumped), looking up at the owner's face direction with attentive ears.
slides.shot: from behind the sofa, the dog beside the owner looking up at them

slides.text:
帰ってきたあなたは、
ソファに沈みこんだ
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind in a work coat, sinks heavily into the sofa; a bag dropped on the floor; the dog trots toward the sofa from the hallway.

slides.text:
ため息がひとつ、
ふたつ
slides.scene: The owner's hands rest limply on their knees on the sofa; the dog on the floor in front looks up at them.
slides.shot: low angle from the floor, the dog in the foreground facing the owner

slides.text:
それから、ぼくに
話しはじめる
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, turns toward the dog sitting on the sofa next to them, one hand gesturing slightly as if talking.
slides.shot: from behind the owner's shoulder, the dog facing the owner

slides.text:
「今日さ、
うまくいかなかったんだ」
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog's face listening, ears perked, head tilted toward the owner who is off-frame to the left.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog, looking left

slides.text:
ぼくには、
ことばはわからない
slides.scene: The dog tilting its head the other way, puzzled but attentive.

slides.text:
でも、声がいつもより
低いのはわかる
slides.scene: The dog's ears droop slightly as it looks up at the owner's lowered head (owner seen only from behind the shoulder).
slides.shot: over the owner's shoulder toward the dog

slides.text:
だから、となりに
ぴったりくっつく
slides.scene: The dog presses its whole side against the owner's leg on the sofa, leaning in.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog leaning against the owner's leg

slides.text:
あなたの手が、
ぼくの背中をなでる
slides.scene: The owner's hand strokes the dog's back slowly on the sofa.

slides.text:
話すたびに、
声が少しずつ軽くなる
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, sits more upright now, one arm around the dog next to them; warm lamp light.

slides.text:
ぼくは、ときどき
しっぽで返事をする
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog's fluffy tail wagging on the sofa cushion next to the owner's knee.

slides.text:
「聞いてくれて、
ありがとう」
slides.scene: The owner's forehead gently touches the top of the dog's head; only the back of the owner's head and hair visible, no face.
slides.shot: close-up from behind the owner's head

slides.text:
あなたが笑った。
それだけで、ぼくはうれしい
slides.scene: The dog looks up happily at the owner, mouth open in a smile, tail up.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog looking up to the upper left where the owner is

slides.text:
ことばはわからないけど、
あなたの声が好きだ
slides.scene: The dog lying with its chin on the owner's knee, eyes half closed, listening.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog on the knee

slides.text:
おはよう、も
ただいま、も、ぜんぶ
slides.scene: Two small vignettes side by side: the owner's hand patting the dog in morning light at the bedside, and the owner's hand patting the dog at the front door in the evening.

slides.text:
ぼくがあなたの声を
聞ける時間は、限られている
slides.scene: The dog sitting alone on the sofa at night, looking at the owner's empty spot beside it for a moment, calm, the lamp warm.

slides.text:
だから、つまらない話でも
いいんだ
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, sits back down next to the dog holding a mug; the dog wags its tail.

slides.text:
ぼくに、
もっと話しかけて
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog looking straight at the viewer with gentle, hopeful eyes.

slides.text:
ぼくは、ぜんぶ
しっぽで聞いているから
slides.scene: The dog curled on the owner's lap on the sofa, tail wagging slightly.

slides.text:
今日、あなたの子に
どんな話をしましたか？
slides.scene: The owner and the dog on the sofa at night, seen from behind, the dog's head resting on the owner's shoulder.

caption:
ことばはわからないけど、あなたの声が好き。
今日、あなたの子にどんな話をしましたか？
youtube_title: 夜の11時、あなたがぼくに話すこと
self_review: 落ち込みの理由は描かない。16枚目は時間の限りに触れるだけで別れの語なし。締めは『もっと話しかけて』という前向きなお願い。
